description_en: Deletes the metadata of multiple files from a dataset
description_zh: 批量从数据集内删除文件的元信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm batch-delete-file-meta --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --ur-is oss://test-bucket/test-object --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDeleteFileMeta

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html operation
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. You can obtain the name of the dataset from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en: The URIs of the OSS buckets in which the files whose metadata you want to delete are stored. You can specify up to 100 URIs
parameters.name: ur_is
